services.name: Jetty Fishing Charter
services.desc: 4 hours or 6 hours About Our Jetty Charters are aboard our 30’ Panga Center Console SeaPlay I. Our boat offers 360-degree fishability that can be expected from Center Consoles. They are the preferred boat for those enjoying a little more comfort while they fish. Our Galveston Jetty Charter is a short 20 minute boat ride to the fishing grounds. These trips provide the opportunity to get many different species of fish ranging from a few pounds to over 100 lbs. The species if fish you can see on these trips include redfish, speckle trout, flounder, sheepshead, drum, mackerel, and many For all ages! • 4 hour or 6 hour

services.name: Shark Charter
services.desc: 5 hours About This trip is for those who seek the adrenaline-charged thrill of catching a large shark. During the warm summer months, the waters of Galveston are the perfect place to intercept these large predators. We fish shrimp boats, nearshore rigs, anchored ships, and other locations that large sharks frequent. Encounters with large sharks exceeding 100lbs are not uncommon. All of these charters are offered aboard SeaPlay I. The trip length is usually 5 hours. More info 5 hour trip Available May 1st thru August 31st. 6 angler max No Fuel Charge Departs dock at 6:30am All bait For all ages! • 5 hours
